name: 高中物理可视化
description: 2D physics engine for Chinese high-school physics with AI scene JSON + canvas visualization.

zh.name: 高中物理可视化
zh.description: 覆盖高中物理力学/振动波动/电磁/光学/热学/近代物理的 2D 可视化；AI 输出 scene JSON 并驱动播放。

en.name: High-school Physics
en.description: 2D visualizer covering Chinese high-school physics; AI outputs scene JSON and drives playback.

tools.name: phys_validate
tools.description: Validate a physics scene JSON against the schema. Returns {ok, errors[]}. Always validate before phys_load; on failure, fix the JSON and retry.

tools.name: phys_load
tools.description: Load a physics scene JSON into the visualizer (opens the panel). Scene fields: topic, zh, world{xmin,xmax,ymin,ymax,air}, g, bodies[{id,x,y,vx,vy,mass,radius,q,color,label,fixed,bounce,e}], springs[{a,b,k,rest,damping}], fields[{type:'E'|'B',Ex,Ey,Bz}], walls, optics{rays,mirrors,lenses,interfaces}, circuit{type:'RC'|'AC',...}, plots[{id,of:'body.prop'}], dt. Coordinates: +x right, +y up; gravity pulls -y.

tools.name: phys_step
tools.description: Advance a few simulation steps while paused.

tools.name: phys_reset
tools.description: Reset the scene to its initial state.

tools.name: phys_state
tools.description: Read current simulation state (t, body positions/velocities, circuit).

tools.name: phys_list_examples
tools.description: List built-in example scenes covering Chinese high-school physics topics.

tools.name: phys_load_example
tools.description: Load a built-in example by id (from phys_list_examples).
